seo.title: La Brew Tabu Cafe | Coffee, Brunch & Pizza in Al Nahda
seo.description: La Brew Tabu Cafe, 3rd Street, Al Nahda: Spanish lattes, matcha, eggs benedict, pasta, pizza and sliders. Open daily 7 AM to 1 AM. Rated 4.9 from 310 Google reviews.

hero.lede: A cosy all-day café in Al Nahda: specialty coffee, matcha, brunch plates, pasta, pizza and sliders, served from 7 AM to 1 AM by a crew regulars call family.
